hooks.text: 不同效果的鬼牌随机染色插入轨道，靠出牌消除形成三消式卡牌战
hooks.excerpt: We’ve blended the classic match-3 mechanic into roguelike deckbuilding game,where different effect ghost's cards randomly take on various colors and are inserted into the battle track, making card battles more dynamic.Players need to play their cards to eliminate the ghosts on the track,and complete the tasks as quickly as possible!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每个十字路口都要根据当前状态决定硬闯强鬼、探索未知或暂避休息
hooks.excerpt: At the crossroads,players need to decide based on their current situation whether to confront the powerful ghosts head-on,explore the unknown, or avoid danger and take a moment to rest.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 击败鬼怪会留下幼体，可培养好感换能力，但携带不同幼体也会附带负面效果
hooks.excerpt: Defeat a dangerous ghost,the“ ghost larva ”will automatically be stored in your Ghost Nursery .Players can cultivate them to gain extra abilities. Bringing the right ghost larva into battle,grants special buffs. At the same time,higher favorability will also unlock more unique ability effects and various mysterious collectibles. Carrying different ghost larvae will also have different negative effects,so be sure to choose carefully!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
